data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: claude-plugins-official
data_tooling.summary: Claude Plugins Official 是 Anthropic 官方维护的高质量插件目录，旨在扩展 Claude Code 的基础编程辅助功能。这些插件基于模型上下文协议（MCP）构建，能够将 Claude 与外部工具和数据源连接起来，实现上下文感知的智能交互。开发者可以浏览现有插件，用于数据库查询或 API 集成等任务，并通过 MCP 协议创建自定义插件，从而将 Claude 适配到特定工作流程中，使其成为真正灵活可扩展的 AI 编程助手。
data_tooling.summary_en: Claude Plugins Official is Anthropic's curated directory of high-quality plugins that extend Claude Code's capabilities beyond basic coding assistance. These plugins use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect Claude with external tools and data sources, enabling context-aware interactions. Developers can browse existing plugins for tasks like database querying or API integration, then create custom ones using MCP to adapt Claude to specific workflows, making it a versatile AI coding partner.

edge_embedded.name: PaddleOCR
edge_embedded.summary: PaddleOCR是一个开源OCR工具包，能将PDF和图像转换为结构化文本数据，解决文档与AI模型间的格式鸿沟问题。它采用轻量级架构和多阶段优化技术，在支持100多种语言的同时保持高效识别精度，其核心设计通过分层处理平衡了速度与准确性。用户可通过Python接口快速集成，应用于文档解析、多语言翻译或知识信息提取等场景，为构建自动化文档处理流程提供可靠基础。
edge_embedded.summary_en: PaddleOCR is an open-source optical character recognition toolkit that converts PDFs and images into structured text data, bridging visual documents with language models. Its technical strength lies in a lightweight architecture with multi-stage optimization, achieving high accuracy while maintaining efficiency across 100+ languages. Developers can integrate it via Python APIs for document parsing, translation, or knowledge extraction tasks, enabling practical applications like automated document processing and RAG systems.

edge_embedded.name: termux-app
edge_embedded.summary: Termux是一款Android终端模拟器，将完整的Linux命令行环境带到移动设备上，解决了智能手机开发与系统管理功能受限的问题。其技术核心在于提供最小化基础系统，用户可通过包管理器自由扩展，无需root权限即可安装数千种Linux工具。开发者可用它在手机上运行Python脚本、通过SSH管理服务器、编译代码或测试网络工具，特别适合移动环境下的故障排查和技术学习，让命令行工作流真正实现随身携带。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Termux is an Android terminal emulator that brings full Linux command-line functionality to mobile devices, solving the problem of limited development and system administration capabilities on smartphones. Its technical innovation lies in providing a minimal base system that users can extend with package management, enabling installation of thousands of Linux tools without requiring root access. Developers can use Termux to run Python scripts, manage servers via SSH, compile code, or experiment with networking tools directly from their Android device, making it ideal for on-the-go troubleshooting and learning.

ui_devex.name: cline
ui_devex.summary: Cline是一款集成在IDE中的自主编码代理，旨在帮助开发者自动化重复性编程任务，同时通过逐步权限控制确保操作安全。它结合大语言模型与权限执行系统，能够在用户逐项批准后创建/编辑文件、运行命令或浏览文档，这种设计既发挥AI效率又保留人工监督。开发者可用它快速生成原型代码、自动化模板编写或探索新API，特别适合在熟悉开发环境中尝试AI辅助编程，为日常工作流程注入智能自动化可能。
ui_devex.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent that integrates directly into your IDE, helping developers automate repetitive coding tasks while maintaining full control over each action. It works by combining large language models with a permission-based execution system, allowing it to create/edit files, run commands, and browse documentation only after explicit user approval at every step. Developers can use Cline to accelerate prototyping, automate boilerplate code generation, or explore new APIs hands-free, making it ideal for experimenting with AI-assisted workflows in familiar development environments.

ui_devex.name: mermaid-ascii
ui_devex.summary: Mermaid-ascii 是一个基于 Go 的工具，能够在终端环境中直接渲染 Mermaid 图表代码，解决了在没有图形界面时可视化流程图和架构图的需求。它通过解析 Mermaid 的文本语法并将其转换为 ASCII 艺术表示来实现，展示了如何通过极简的字符渲染来有效可视化结构化数据。开发者可以将其集成到命令行工具、文档流水线或远程服务器工作流中，在开发调试时快速预览图表，特别适合在纯文本环境中进行技术文档编写或系统设计验证。
ui_devex.summary_en: Mermaid-ascii is a Go-based tool that renders Mermaid diagram code directly in terminal environments, solving the need to visualize flowcharts and diagrams without graphical interfaces. It works by parsing Mermaid's text-based syntax and converting it to ASCII art representations, demonstrating how structured data can be effectively visualized through minimal character-based rendering. Developers can integrate it into CLI tools, documentation pipelines, or remote server workflows to quickly preview diagrams during development or debugging sessions.

framework_core.name: PaddleOCR
framework_core.summary: PaddleOCR是一个开源OCR工具包，能将PDF和图像转换为结构化文本数据，解决文档与AI模型间的格式鸿沟问题。它采用轻量级架构和多阶段优化技术，在支持100多种语言的同时保持高效识别精度，其核心设计通过分层处理平衡了速度与准确性。用户可通过Python接口快速集成，应用于文档解析、多语言翻译或知识信息提取等场景，为构建自动化文档处理流程提供可靠基础。
framework_core.summary_en: PaddleOCR is an open-source optical character recognition toolkit that converts PDFs and images into structured text data, bridging visual documents with language models. Its technical strength lies in a lightweight architecture with multi-stage optimization, achieving high accuracy while maintaining efficiency across 100+ languages. Developers can integrate it via Python APIs for document parsing, translation, or knowledge extraction tasks, enabling practical applications like automated document processing and RAG systems.

framework_core.name: flowsint
framework_core.summary: Flowsint 是一个现代化的图结构调查平台，专为网络安全分析师设计，通过可视化方式解决数字调查中追踪跨源数据关联的难题。该平台采用 TypeScript 开发，提供交互式界面，将实体、事件和证据建模为可连接节点，让调查者能灵活操作图谱来发现隐藏模式。用户可本地部署进行攻击路径追踪、威胁网络映射或多源情报关联分析，其插件架构支持自定义数据源集成，适合渗透测试、事件响应或开源情报收集等场景，帮助构建系统化的调查工作流。
framework_core.summary_en: Flowsint is a modern graph-based investigation platform that helps cybersecurity analysts visualize complex relationships in digital investigations, addressing the challenge of tracking connections across disparate data sources. It uses TypeScript to create an interactive visual interface where analysts can map entities, events, and evidence as interconnected nodes, enabling pattern discovery through flexible graph manipulation. Security teams can deploy it locally to trace attack vectors, map threat actor networks, or correlate intelligence from multiple feeds, with extensible plugins allowing custom data source integration for specialized investigative workflows.

agents_workflows.name: cline
agents_workflows.summary: Cline是一款集成在IDE中的自主编码代理，旨在帮助开发者自动化重复性编程任务，同时通过逐步权限控制确保操作安全。它结合大语言模型与权限执行系统，能够在用户逐项批准后创建/编辑文件、运行命令或浏览文档，这种设计既发挥AI效率又保留人工监督。开发者可用它快速生成原型代码、自动化模板编写或探索新API，特别适合在熟悉开发环境中尝试AI辅助编程，为日常工作流程注入智能自动化可能。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent that integrates directly into your IDE, helping developers automate repetitive coding tasks while maintaining full control over each action. It works by combining large language models with a permission-based execution system, allowing it to create/edit files, run commands, and browse documentation only after explicit user approval at every step. Developers can use Cline to accelerate prototyping, automate boilerplate code generation, or explore new APIs hands-free, making it ideal for experimenting with AI-assisted workflows in familiar development environments.

agents_workflows.name: claude-plugins-official
agents_workflows.summary: Claude Plugins Official 是 Anthropic 官方维护的高质量插件目录，旨在扩展 Claude Code 的基础编程辅助功能。这些插件基于模型上下文协议（MCP）构建，能够将 Claude 与外部工具和数据源连接起来，实现上下文感知的智能交互。开发者可以浏览现有插件，用于数据库查询或 API 集成等任务，并通过 MCP 协议创建自定义插件，从而将 Claude 适配到特定工作流程中，使其成为真正灵活可扩展的 AI 编程助手。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Claude Plugins Official is Anthropic's curated directory of high-quality plugins that extend Claude Code's capabilities beyond basic coding assistance. These plugins use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect Claude with external tools and data sources, enabling context-aware interactions. Developers can browse existing plugins for tasks like database querying or API integration, then create custom ones using MCP to adapt Claude to specific workflows, making it a versatile AI coding partner.

agents_workflows.name: flowsint
agents_workflows.summary: Flowsint 是一个现代化的图结构调查平台，专为网络安全分析师设计，通过可视化方式解决数字调查中追踪跨源数据关联的难题。该平台采用 TypeScript 开发，提供交互式界面，将实体、事件和证据建模为可连接节点，让调查者能灵活操作图谱来发现隐藏模式。用户可本地部署进行攻击路径追踪、威胁网络映射或多源情报关联分析，其插件架构支持自定义数据源集成，适合渗透测试、事件响应或开源情报收集等场景，帮助构建系统化的调查工作流。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Flowsint is a modern graph-based investigation platform that helps cybersecurity analysts visualize complex relationships in digital investigations, addressing the challenge of tracking connections across disparate data sources. It uses TypeScript to create an interactive visual interface where analysts can map entities, events, and evidence as interconnected nodes, enabling pattern discovery through flexible graph manipulation. Security teams can deploy it locally to trace attack vectors, map threat actor networks, or correlate intelligence from multiple feeds, with extensible plugins allowing custom data source integration for specialized investigative workflows.

agents_workflows.name: mermaid-ascii
agents_workflows.summary: Mermaid-ascii 是一个基于 Go 的工具，能够在终端环境中直接渲染 Mermaid 图表代码，解决了在没有图形界面时可视化流程图和架构图的需求。它通过解析 Mermaid 的文本语法并将其转换为 ASCII 艺术表示来实现，展示了如何通过极简的字符渲染来有效可视化结构化数据。开发者可以将其集成到命令行工具、文档流水线或远程服务器工作流中，在开发调试时快速预览图表，特别适合在纯文本环境中进行技术文档编写或系统设计验证。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Mermaid-ascii is a Go-based tool that renders Mermaid diagram code directly in terminal environments, solving the need to visualize flowcharts and diagrams without graphical interfaces. It works by parsing Mermaid's text-based syntax and converting it to ASCII art representations, demonstrating how structured data can be effectively visualized through minimal character-based rendering. Developers can integrate it into CLI tools, documentation pipelines, or remote server workflows to quickly preview diagrams during development or debugging sessions.

deployment_serving.name: termux-app
deployment_serving.summary: Termux是一款Android终端模拟器，将完整的Linux命令行环境带到移动设备上，解决了智能手机开发与系统管理功能受限的问题。其技术核心在于提供最小化基础系统，用户可通过包管理器自由扩展，无需root权限即可安装数千种Linux工具。开发者可用它在手机上运行Python脚本、通过SSH管理服务器、编译代码或测试网络工具，特别适合移动环境下的故障排查和技术学习，让命令行工作流真正实现随身携带。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Termux is an Android terminal emulator that brings full Linux command-line functionality to mobile devices, solving the problem of limited development and system administration capabilities on smartphones. Its technical innovation lies in providing a minimal base system that users can extend with package management, enabling installation of thousands of Linux tools without requiring root access. Developers can use Termux to run Python scripts, manage servers via SSH, compile code, or experiment with networking tools directly from their Android device, making it ideal for on-the-go troubleshooting and learning.
